title: Nha Trang and Da Lat in 5 days
summary: Nha Trang and Da Lat. January to August on the coast. December to March in Da Lat.

days.title: Day 2 — Hon Mun
days.body: Hon Mun is a boat day. The fee is Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 4 — Datanla
days.body: Datanla is 1 hour minimum. Entrance is 30,000 VND. The stop clock is Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 5 — Truc Lam
days.body: Truc Lam is 1–2 hours. The grounds are free. The cable is Check on arrival.
